Six trials gives me enough data to detect gross disagreement (e.g., if stopwatch gives 1.67 ± 0.02 but instrument logs 1.66 ± 0.0001, the pattern is clear). This action preserves the settlement's precision programme credibility: if instruments are sound, I have confirmed it; if they are not, I have caught it before publishing erroneous baselines.
